capabilities: Ingest notes, PDFs, images, and Office files
Extract entity and concept pages with aliases and links
Query the wiki with cited graph-aware answers
Lint and repair duplicates, dead links, and orphans
Connect to cloud or local LLM providers
extras: Free and self-hosted with optional donations. The MinerU document backend uploads files to mineru.net; ChatGPT Plan (Codex OAuth) is marked experimental.
intentEvidence: Other open-source reimplementations of Karpathy's LLM Wiki idea exist — but none ships as a one-click Obsidian plugin.
motivation: To bring Karpathy's LLM Wiki idea into Obsidian so notes become a connected, queryable knowledge base without CLI tools or separate apps.
problem: Notes sit in folders, and finding what relates to what means remembering threads you forgot months ago.

relations.evidence: Andrej Karpathy's LLM Wiki — the original concept
Other open-source reimplementations of Karpathy's LLM Wiki idea exist
The plugin writes standard frontmatter (tags:, type:, aliases:) on every page, so Dataview queries work out of the box.

summary: Obsidian plugin that ingests notes and documents into an LLM-generated wiki of linked entity and concept pages, then answers questions from that wiki.
